name: Stream Rapids
summary: Stream Rapids turns your Twitch chat into a boat race. Viewers type !play to join, or scan a QR code with their phone, and race down a new river every round with rapids, rocks, whirlpools and a waterfall. It runs in the browser as an OBS source, with no download. Party Mode puts the race on a big screen for parties and classrooms, with everyone playing on their phone.
